entries.en: Added helpful hint to run `security unlock-keychain` when encountering API key errors on macOS with locked keychain
entries.zh: 添加了有用的提示，以在 macOS 上遇到具有锁定钥匙串的 API 密钥错误时运行“安全解锁钥匙串”

entries.en: Added `allowUnsandboxedCommands` sandbox setting to disable the dangerouslyDisableSandbox escape hatch at policy level
entries.zh: 添加了`allowUnsandboxedCommands`沙箱设置，以在策略级别禁用危险的DisableSandbox逃生舱口

entries.en: Added `disallowedTools` field to custom agent definitions for explicit tool blocking
entries.zh: 在自定义代理定义中添加了`disallowedTools`字段，以实现显式工具阻止
添加了基于提示的停止挂钩

entries.en: VSCode: Added respectGitIgnore configuration to include .gitignored files in file searches (defaults to true)
entries.zh: VS Code：新增 respectGitIgnore 配置，可在文件搜索中包含被 .gitignore 忽略的文件（默认为 true）

entries.en: Enabled SSE MCP servers on native build
entries.zh: 在本机构建上启用 SSE MCP 服务器

entries.en: Fixed Explore agent creating unwanted .md investigation files during codebase exploration
entries.zh: 修复了探索代理在代码库探索期间创建不需要的 .md 调查文件的问题

entries.en: Fixed a bug where `/context` would sometimes fail with "max_tokens must be greater than thinking.budget_tokens" error message
entries.zh: 修复了 `/context` 有时会失败并显示“max_tokens 必须大于 Thinking.budget_tokens”错误消息的错误

entries.en: Fixed `--mcp-config` flag to correctly override file-based MCP configurations
entries.zh: 修复了`--mcp-config`标志以正确覆盖基于文件的 MCP 配置

entries.en: Fixed bug that saved session permissions to local settings
entries.zh: 修复了将会话权限保存到本地设置的错误

entries.en: Fixed MCP tools not being available to sub-agents
entries.zh: 修复了子代理无法使用 MCP 工具的问题

entries.en: Fixed hooks and plugins not executing when using --dangerously-skip-permissions flag
entries.zh: 修复了使用 --dangerously-skip-permissions 标志时不执行的挂钩和插件

entries.en: Fixed delay when navigating through typeahead suggestions with arrow keys
entries.zh: 修复了使用箭头键浏览输入建议时的延迟

entries.en: VSCode: Restored selection indicator in input footer showing current file or code selection status
entries.zh: VS Code：恢复了输入框底部显示当前文件或代码选择状态的选择指示器

entries.en: Deprecated output styles. Review options in `/output-style` and use --system-prompt-file, --system-prompt, --append-system-prompt, CLAUDE.md, or plugins instead
entries.zh: 已弃用的输出样式。查看 `/output-style` 中的选项并使用 --system-prompt-file、--system-prompt、--append-system-prompt、CLAUDE.md 或插件代替

entries.en: Removed support for custom ripgrep configuration, resolving an issue where Search returns no results and config discovery fails
entries.zh: 移除对自定义 ripgrep 配置的支持，解决搜索返回空结果、配置查找失败的问题
